changes.statement: Extreme Runtime can reuse the dispatcher-captured fixed target graph directly from runtime-owned 96-token buffers and metadata without retaining ModelRunner. Across 64 real-weight cycles on DP1xTP8 it preserves exact state, host mirrors and rank parity while reducing median cycle wall from 433.587 to 53.286 ms and raising internal decode-window throughput from 38.271 to 294.400 tok/s.
